lessons_used: Sign-in hints consistently drove winning tests, whereas hints on other steps showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Desktop hotkey setup screens, guide screens, and quick-action redesigns on the finish step were consistently helpful.
Wait-stage info and waiting progress updates produced wins on home and adoption steps, though several showed no clear effect.
Layout modifications and copy updates consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most other new screens and flows showed no clear effect or hurt performance, occasionally causing early test stops due to negative impact.
Predictions underestimated gains for finish-step hotkey and quick-action improvements while overestimating gains for ineffective changes.

candidates.title: Sign-In Cloud Pet Restore Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in restores all previously adopted pets and cloud progress.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in. Lessons show sign-in hints consistently drive winning tests.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically restores your saved pets and progress from previous sessions.

guard.reason: Valid hint addition to sign-in screen compliant with onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints consistently drive winning tests (+1.9% historical average).

candidates.title: Home Intro Hotkey Action Center Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro welcome section to include a prominent hotkey checklist showing core pet actions.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to pets. Lessons show hotkey setup and quick-action redesigns on the finish step are consistently effective.

home_welcome.text: Quick Hotkeys: Press Alt+P to toggle visibility, Alt+H to hide, Alt+C to open chat

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Quick Hotkey Interactive Desktop Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated desktop hotkey reference screen at the finish step before launching the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Finish step median time is 395s with users confused about controls. Lessons prove hotkey guide screens on the finish step perform strongly.

new_hotkey_guide.headline: Master Desktop Pet Hotkeys
new_hotkey_guide.body: Try out your pet controls so you can interact with your companion effortlessly.

components.text: Alt+P: Show/Hide Pet | Alt+M: Mute Audio | Alt+C: Chat Box

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Preparation Status Info
candidates.change: Display explicit status info and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets initialize.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time reaches a median of 201s and mean of 2336s. Lessons show wait-stage info on the home step improves retention.

waiting.hint: Preparing high-res desktop animations. Your pet will launch automatically in moments.

guard.reason: Valid status info and time estimate update during a real wait on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Wait-stage info on home step effectively addresses severe wait time dropoff.

candidates.title: Adoption Customization Trait Processing Wait Info
candidates.change: Add progress updates and estimated wait time during photo upload processing.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 65.2% conversion rate with long tail wait times (mean 1017s) and failed custom generation reports. Lessons note wait-stage info helps adoption steps.

upload_photos.hint: Analyzing photo features and building pet behaviors... Processing takes around 1-2 minutes.

guard.reason: Valid processing progress and time estimate display on the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest funnel bottleneck (34.8% loss) with high historical test lift (+5.3%).

candidates.title: Sign-In Multi-Device Account Sync Hint
candidates.change: Show a clear reassurance hint during sign-in stating that pets sync automatically across all user devices.
candidates.why: Addresses account support emails regarding lost pets after re-signing in. Sign-in hints are proven high performers in previous tests.

sign_in.hint: Your pet progress and customizations automatically transfer across all signed-in devices.

guard.reason: Valid account sync hint added to sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addressing verified user sync support issues with proven gain.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Setup Flow
candidates.change: Insert a short interactive setup flow at the end of onboarding for practicing basic pet controls.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails asked how to control or minimize pets after setup. Finish step interaction features are consistently effective according to test lessons.

new_interaction_flow.headline: Practice Controlling Your Pet
new_interaction_flow.body: Test your hotkeys now to summon, hide, or chat with your new pet.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an interactive pet interaction setup flow after home intro.

candidates.score_note: New flows and screens tend to hurt conversion (-1.5% historical average) and carry high dev cost.

candidates.title: Choose Path First Sequence Reorder
candidates.change: Move path selection ahead of the story introduction screen so users choose their companion path immediately.
candidates.why: Starting with the story screen creates initial delay (median 8s / mean 514s on choose_path). Leading with path choice engages users right away.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Ready System Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop system notifications when background pet rendering finishes during the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait time has a mean of 2336s. System notifications allow users to safely switch windows without missing when their pet is ready.

waiting.hint: We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready to appear on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid system notification configuration on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Desktop notifications re-engage users during long background initialization (+2.2% lift).

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Security and Pet Memory Hint
candidates.change: Add sign-in copy confirming that user accounts safely retain pet personality data and certificate records.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited reset pet data after signing in. Lessons show sign-in reassurance hints consistently drive winning test results.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your adoption certificate and preserves pet personality data safe in the cloud.

guard.reason: Valid hint explaining cloud memory and certificate backup on sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Low risk text change addressing data loss concerns based on strong historical wins.

decisions.title: Adoption Customization Trait Processing Wait Info

lessons_next: Sign-in hints produced multiple significant wins, whereas hints on other steps showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Desktop hotkey setup screens, guide screens, and quick-action redesigns on the finish step were helpful and drove strong wins.
Wait-stage info updates on home and adoption steps yielded several wins, though many showed no clear effect.
Layout modifications and copy updates consistently resulted in no clear effect or worse performance, with zero wins.
Most other new screens and flows showed no clear effect or hurt performance, occasionally triggering early test stops.
Predictions underestimated gains for finish-step hotkey and quick-action improvements while overestimating gains for ineffective changes.
